title: Component polish: fix ComboBox hitTest off-by-one + arrow toggle + extraTextFields signature
description:
DONE (agent-1237). Three static-analysis fixes in packages/swf/src/compiler/components.ts, all verified firsthand:

(1) HIGH ComboBox onMouseDown hit-test off-by-one: removed trailing '+ this.__rowHeight' so the gate is 'my <= bottom'. bottom = _y + __rowTop + (open ? items*__rowHeight : 0); __rowTop = ROW_HEIGHT (collapsed row on top). Closed box accepts only its single top row; open box accepts collapsed row + N item rows. No phantom row.

(2) LOW ControlSpec.extraTextFields: marked height optional ('width: number, height?: number') so the (w)-only List/ComboBox impls type-check while the call site still passes both. No behavior change.

(3) MINOR arrow_mk toggle: __setOpen now 'this.arrow_mk._visible = !this.__open' guarded by 'if (this.arrow_mk != undefined)'.

TESTS (component-place.test.ts, 'corrected hit-test boundary (task 1237)' + arrow toggle): click just below COLLAPSED row is OUTSIDE; with dropdown OPEN a click below last item is OUTSIDE; authored gate drops phantom row; __setOpen toggles arrow_mk. Precise Ruffle hit oracle impractical (headless Ruffle does not dispatch global onMouseDown clip events) -> boundary asserted STRUCTURALLY vs authored AS2 source + simulated runtime arithmetic.

GREEN: pnpm --filter @flash/swf build clean; swf suite 115 files / 1444 tests pass (+4 new); component-oracle e2e 15/15 pass incl. ComboBox toggle (click at collapsed y=40 still opens). No regression. docs/13 updated.
